decisions.reason: The schlager compilation CD required modest investment and attracted little public commitment, but it fits the firm's stated aim of broadening genres and catalog items, and catalog titles in a warehouse-backed online shop are rarely withdrawn after a single year, so keeping it is the more likely outcome.

The illustrated release series is a multi-model product line that builds on the label's core identity of carefully produced editions, so the firm has invested heavily and committed to it visibly, and with only one year of results any weakness can still be attributed to temporary causes, all of which favor persisting with it.
